title: Bug: [read_mac] Module doesn't run without -u flag
author: sarabjeetsingh1509
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

read_mac module needs few arguments like "--image1", "--image2". However, it can only be executed with -u flag, i.e., when pre-test and post-test are skipped. 

If we pass these arguments without -u option, it fails with following error

```
ERROR: usage: __main__.py [options] [file_or_dir] [file_or_dir] [...]
__main__.py: error: unrecognized arguments: --image1=http://xxx/sonic-marvell-teralynx.bin --image2=http://xxx/sonic-marvell-teralynx.bin
  inifile: /var/AzDevOps/sonic-mgmt/sonic-mgmt/tests/pytest.ini
  rootdir: /var/AzDevOps/sonic-mgmt/sonic-mgmt/tests

!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!  Prepare DUT failed, skip testing  !!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Execute PTF or specific read_mac module without -u flag, i.e., following command:

```
./run_tests.sh -n ptf2-m -d yyy -c  "read_mac" -f ../ansible/testbed.yaml -i ../ansible/lab,../ansible/veos -e --image1=http://xxx/sonic-marvell-teralynx.bin -e --image2=http://xxx/sonic-marvell-teralynx.bin -t t0,any
```


### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

**Actual Behavior:**

Test case only executes when -u option is added, i.e., when pre-test and post-test are skipped.


**Expected Behavior:**

Test case should be able to run with or without pre-test and post-test, i.e., with or without -u option.

### Description of PR
read_mac module needs few arguments like "--image1", "--image2". However, it can only be executed with -u flag, i.e., when pre-test and post-test are skipped.
Currently it fails with following message if -u option is not added:

```
ERROR: usage: __main__.py [options] [file_or_dir] [file_or_dir] [...]
__main__.py: error: unrecognized arguments: --image1=http://xxx/sonic-marvell-teralynx.bin --image2=http://xxx/sonic-marvell-teralynx.bin
```

Summary:
Fixes #18454 

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix

- [x] Test case improvement


### Back port request
- [ ] 202405

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
As part of global PTF run, this module was not run as required options like "--image1", "--image2" are not recognized.
However, when individual module was executed with -u (i.e., by skipping pretest and posttest), module was run.
Intention is to be able to execute the read_mac component as part of global run.

#### How did you do it?
Moved the read_mac parser option to global space.
